response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_rate FROM media_type_stats) SELECT AVG(m.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(m.bytes_per_millisecond - b.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_above_average FROM media_type_stats AS m CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE m.bytes_per_millisecond > b.avg_rate;
